author: zhangYiIntel
title: PyTorch Detectron2 model hub tests fail: pretrained weight download SSL certificate expired on dl.fbaipublicfiles.com
signature: detectron2 pretrained weight download fails: URLError CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED certificate has expired when downloading model_final weights via iopath PathManager from dl.fbaipublicfiles.com|External Service

failed_jobs.symptom: All 19 test_detectron2_precommit parametrized cases failed with ProcessError wrapping URLError CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED while downloading pretrained weights

failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check failed because the PyTorch Models tests job failed

root_cause: All 19 Detectron2 precommit test cases fail at model-load time, not at OpenVINO conversion time. Detectron2's DetectionCheckpointer resolves pretrained weight URLs via iopath's PathManager, which downloads from the third-party host dl.fbaipublicfiles.com (Facebook AI Research public file storage). That host's TLS certificate has expired, so every urllib.request.urlretrieve call fails TLS verification with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED / certificate has expired, after 3 retries. This is an upstream external-service outage unrelated to OpenVINO source changes; the triggering commit (#39201, CPU QSAIndexer/SparsePA kernels) does not touch any model-hub test code or network/TLS configuration.
reproduction_steps: Run `pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_detectron2.py -k test_detectron2_precommit` locally (or `curl -v https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/detectron2/COCO-Detection/faster_rcnn_R_50_FPN_1x/137257794/model_final_b275ba.pkl`) while dl.fbaipublicfiles.com's certificate is expired; the download step fails identically outside CI.
recommended_actions: No source-code fix needed; monitor dl.fbaipublicfiles.com and re-run the PyTorch Models tests job once Facebook AI Research renews the certificate.

Consider adding a CI-side retry/backoff with a longer total wait window, or temporarily skipping/marking test_detectron2_precommit as xfail(reason='upstream cert expired') if the outage persists beyond a few hours, to avoid blocking other post-commit signal.
Optionally mirror Detectron2 pretrained weights to an internal/controlled storage location to remove the dependency on dl.fbaipublicfiles.com for CI stability.
prevention_strategies: This category of failure (third-party host certificate expiry) cannot be prevented by code changes; mitigate impact by: (1) isolating model-hub download failures from merge-blocking status where feasible, (2) adding a lightweight pre-flight certificate/reachability check for dl.fbaipublicfiles.com with a clear 'external dependency unavailable' message instead of a generic ProcessError, and (3) mirroring frequently used external model weights to infrastructure under OpenVINO's control.
historical_context: Identical signature (4014ef1f5a5e54e7) previously recorded twice on 2026-11-12 (first_seen 2026-11-12T01:42:28Z, runs 43127638525 and 43127634633), both also detectron2 CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED failures on dl.fbaipublicfiles.com. This is now the 3rd consecutive occurrence within the same day, indicating the upstream certificate outage is still unresolved.
